title_sq: Ne Rrugen Ndre Mjeda, Tek Kompleksi Star Shitet Ambient Komercial Me Cmim Okazion!
description_sq: Ne Rrugen Ndre Mjeda, tek kompleksi Star shitet ambient komercial me cmim Okazion. Ambienti ka nje siperfaqe neto prej 195 m2 dhe mund te perdoret per lloje te ndryshme biznesi. Se fundmi ne ambient jane investuar sistemi i aspirimit, vetratat e jashtme te cilat jane dopio xham me palosje dhe ndarje me gips te ambienteve te brendshme. Ambienti ka fasade xhami ne te gjithe gjatesin e tij, gjithashtu ambienti ka akses nga te dyja anet e kompleksit. Aktualisht kompleksi eshte ne fazen perfundimtare ku disa prej ambienteve komerciale kan filluar aktivitetin.
title_en: On the street Ndre Mjeda, near the Star complex, commercial space for sale at a bargain price!
description_en: On Ndre Mjeda Street, at the Star complex, commercial premises are for sale at bargain prices. The environment has a net surface of 195 m2 and can be used for different types of business. Recently, the aspiration system, the external windows, which are double-glazed with folding and plaster partitions of the interior, have been invested in the environment. The environment has glass facades along its entire length, also the environment has access from both sides of the complex. Currently, the complex is in the final phase where some of the commercial premises have started their activity.
